title: The Wicked Flee When No One Pursues

questions.question: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:1 (ESV): "but the righteous are bold as a lion."

questions.question: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law strive against whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:4 (ESV): "but those who keep the law strive against them."

questions.question: Better is a poor man who walks in his integrity than a rich man who is crooked in his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:6 (ESV): "than a rich man who is crooked in his ways."

questions.question: Whoever conceals his transgressions will not prosper, but he who confesses and forsakes them will obtain what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:13 (ESV): "but he who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy."

questions.question: The one who trusts in himself is a fool, but the one who walks in wisdom will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:26 (ESV): "but the one who walks in wisdom will be delivered."

questions.question: When a land transgresses, it has many rulers, but with a man of understanding and knowledge, its stability will do what?
A poor man who oppresses the poor is a beating rain that leaves no what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:3 (ESV): "is a beating rain that leaves no food."

questions.question: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the Lord understand it how?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:5 (ESV): "but those who seek the Lord understand it completely."

questions.question: Whoever keeps the law is a discerning son, but a companion of gluttons shames his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:7 (ESV): "but a companion of gluttons shames his father."

questions.question: If one turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:9 (ESV): "even his prayer is an abomination."

questions.question: Whoever multiplies his wealth by interest and profit gathers it for him who is generous to the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:8 (ESV): "gathers it for him who is generous to the poor."

questions.question: A rich man is wise in his own eyes, but a poor man who has understanding will do what to him?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:11 (ESV): "but a poor man who has understanding will find him out."

questions.question: As a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:15 (ESV): "is a wicked ruler over a poor people."

questions.question: A man burdened with the blood of another will be a fugitive until death; let no one do what?
To show partiality is not good, but for a piece of bread a man will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:21 (ESV): "but for a piece of bread a man will transgress."

key_verse_text: Whoever conceals his transgressions will not prosper, but he who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy.
